title: Artin approximation of an object over a complete local ring
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The chapter's approximation engine: write R as a colimit of finite-type Lambda-algebras and pull x back to x_C; build a surjection from a completed polynomial ring P onto R with exact sequence P^{t} -> P^{r} -> P -> R -> 0 whose first two maps the Artin-Rees choice of N controls; apply the G-ring assumption through the smoothing approximation theorem to get an etale B approximating all data modulo (m')^N; set A = B/(b') and match associated graded algebras via the approximate-complex lemma; finally replace the essentially-finite-type A by a finite-type localization using limit preservation on objects.
